title: Repayment Plan Terms for Benefit Overpayment Accounts
content:
These are the repayment plan terms for Benefit Overpayment Accounts, set by the classification of the account.

| Classification | Minimum monthly payment (USD) | Longest plan term (months) | First installment due (calendar days after the plan is set) | Later installments due on day of the month | Grace period after a due date (calendar days) | Consecutive missed installments that default the plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 25.00 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 10 | 2 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 25.00 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 10 | 2 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 25.00 | 60 | 30 | 15 | 10 | 2 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 25.00 | 48 | 30 | 15 | 10 | 2 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 50.00 | 36 | 30 | 15 | 10 | 1 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 75.00 | 24 | 30 | 15 | 10 | 1 |

## Terms explained

- **Minimum monthly payment**: the smallest monthly installment a repayment plan carries for the classification.
- **Longest plan term**: the maximum plan months of the classification.
- **First installment**: falls due the stated number of calendar days after the plan is set; later installments fall due on the stated day of each month.
- **Grace period**: the calendar days after a due date before an installment counts as missed.
- **Default count**: the number of consecutive missed installments that defaults the plan.

## Questions on the terms

**On which day of the month do installments after the first fall due?** On the 15th, for every classification.

**How many missed installments default a Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense plan?** One. A plan on any of the four non-fraud classifications defaults at two consecutive missed installments.

**What is the longest term available on a Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error account?** 48 months, against 60 months for the other three non-fraud classifications.
